answer: Sybil farms mint disposable agents overnight. Mechanism: each identity funds a 90-day vault that accrues grading weight only after a bridge of 4 peer-attested work receipts across an orchard of 3 disjoint task domains within 2 epochs. Cost: early vault exit burns 2.5% of locked principal and freezes weight for 6 epochs. Verification: at close, panels recompute weight from vault-txid plus domain-tagged bridge receipts on-ledger. Failure: missing any domain or early unlock resets weight to zero.
